plan.notes: Source: official College of Southern Idaho 2024-2025 catalog, 'Outdoor Recreation Leadership, Associate of Arts' program page (Major Code: 1930R), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from https://csi.smartcatalogiq.com/en/2024-2025/2024-2025-catalog/agriculture-department/outdoor-recreation-leadership/outdoor-recreation-leadership-associate-of-arts . Transcription method: fetched the official program page and transcribed the published requirement tables verbatim (course codes, titles, credits, printed semester totals).  TRUE award: Associate of Arts (page title 'Outdoor Recreation Leadership, Associate of Arts'; the program page lists BTC, ITC, and AA awards - the AA is the flagship degree modeled here). Catalog year 2024-2025: the newest CSI catalog with complete published program pages found (a 2025-2026 catalog exists but its program pages were not locatable; the 2024-2025 pages are complete and officially published). Total credits: 60, the catalog's published minimum ('Total Credit Hours: 60-61'); semester tables print 15/15/14-15/16 and sum exactly at the minimum path. Variable credit: 'SCIG GE Any Gen. Ed. Science Course 3-4 Credits' modeled at 3 (minimum-credit path). Choice slots: PROG ELEC 12 hours total (3 + 6 + 3 across semesters; student choice from the official HREC program-electives list printed on the page - e.g. HREC 120/135/136/137/140-153/241/242/244/247/248); MATH GE / SOCS GE / COMM GE / SCIG GE / SCIG GE2 / SOCS GE2 / HUMA GE1 / HUMA GE2 / WELL GE are official catalog placeholders (student choice). Footnote: Humanities courses must be from 2 different disciplines. The catalog notes 'Alternative plans of study available by contacting your advisor.' Prereqs: left empty. The catalog marks courses with '*' as 'Prerequisite or corequisite required' but does not name the prerequisite on the plan page; per-course prerequisites live on the official catalog course pages, not the plan page.
